name: ds007 - EU Power of Attorney (EU PoA) – SD-JWT VC payload
description: Schema for the SD-JWT VC payload of an EU PoA as defined in the EU PoA Rulebook (rb-eu-poa, Chapter 3.2). This models the JSON claims set prior to SD-JWT disclosure/packing. The attestation is a single flat object; selective disclosure per claim is specified in the rulebook, not here.

display.name: EU Power of Attorney (EU PoA)
display.description: Schema for the SD-JWT VC payload of an EU PoA as defined in the EU PoA Rulebook (rb-eu-poa, Chapter 3.2). This models the JSON claims set prior to SD-JWT disclosure/packing. The attestation is a single flat object; selective disclosure per claim is specified in the rulebook, not here.

claims.description: Legal full name of the attorney (delegate).
Type of identification document presented by the attorney. See code list in rulebook section 2.8.
Identification document number of the attorney.
Residential address of the attorney, as one string.
End date of validity of the PoA (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD). Later than validity_period_valid_from (IR-01).
Legal category of the attestation as defined by eIDAS 2.
Registered office address of the company, as one string.
Date the PoA was executed (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD). Equal to or earlier than validity_period_valid_from (IR-02).
EUID reference of the company on whose behalf the PoA is granted.
Name of the business register in which the company is registered.
Name of the administrative authority that issued the EU PoA, or the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the Member State if there is no separate authority entitled to issue the EU PoA.
Date of birth of the principal (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).
Type of identification document presented by the principal. See code list in rulebook section 2.8.
Location of the business register.
Date of birth of the attorney (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).

display.label: Scope Of Representation Power Of Substitution

claims.description: Whether the attorney may delegate the granted powers to a third party. If 'limited', the limitation details are included in scope_of_representation_powers (IR-04).
Place of birth of the principal.
Registered legal name of the company.
Country of incorporation, alpha-2 country code as specified in ISO 3166-1.
Date the PoA was signed (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).
Alpha-2 country code, as specified in ISO 3166-1, of the country or territory of the provider of the attestation.
Identification document number of the principal.
Residential address of the principal, as one string.
Legal form of the company (e.g. B.V., GmbH, SARL, SA).
Governing Member State law, alpha-2 country code as specified in ISO 3166-1.
Legal full name of the principal, the natural person who grants the PoA on behalf of the company.
Place of birth of the attorney.

The powers granted to the attorney, taken from the six powers listed in rulebook section 2.8. If scope_of_representation_power_of_substitution is 'limited', the limitation details are added to this array as well (IR-04); otherwise only the six listed powers are allowed.
Start date of validity of the PoA (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).
Place where the PoA was signed.
URL at which a machine-readable version of the trust anchor to be used for verifying the EU PoA can be found or looked up.
